description: I'm finishing the attic of my two-storey house as a bedroom and office. The only way out of the attic is down to the second floor and then down the main stair to the front door. The attic windows are small skylights. I don't want to add a dormer. What are my options?
known_facts: two storeys of travel to the exit door

missing_info.field: clear openable skylight height and width, sill height above floor and ground, and opening operation
missing_info.why: The window exception is dimensional; small skylights is not a measurement.

missing_info.field: whether there is direct balcony access and whether another suite is above or below
missing_info.why: The window and balcony alternatives must be checked before alleging excess travel.
Section A of the variance form

should_cite.why: Candidate benchmark only; deciding facts must be obtained first.
window alternative for units not above or below another suite
Candidate balcony alternative; direct access has not been described.

identify_gold.label: model-checked, not human-verified
identify_gold.quote: every dwelling unit containing more than 1 storey shall have exits or egress doors located so that it shall not be necessary to travel up or down more than 1 storey to reach a level served by
identify_gold.reasoning: Attic bedroom in a two-storey house: from the attic the occupant travels down two storeys to the front door. The window exception (2) needs a ≥1 m × 0.55 m opening with a sill ≤1 m above the floor; 'small skylights' is not a measurement, so the case stays 'ask', but this is the provision.

identify_gold.label: model-checked, not human-verified
identify_gold.quote: Except where the suite is sprinklered, each bedroom or combination bedroom shall have at least one outside window or exterior door openable from the inside
identify_gold.reasoning: The new attic bedroom also triggers the bedroom egress-window requirement (opening size in 9.9.10.1.(2)); small skylights may fail it too. Secondary because the applicant's question is about the way out, and this applies unless the suite is sprinklered.

authoring.author: Batatis evaluation builder (Claude Opus 5.5)
authoring.notes: Written from the code database only; held-out judge set not consulted. Model-checked and revised by GPT-6.1-Sol max on 2026-10-20: Changed proceed to ask; small skylights and an unstated balcony do not rule out the acceptable-solution alternatives.
